en: Price every cleaning job right and win more quotes
Quotes, rate card, margin and follow-ups for cleaning businesses
Area, rooms, frequency and add-on quote builder
type the area or the rooms, the service, the frequency and the add-ons and get the labour hours, the cleaners, the price of the visit, the cost and the margin
Rate card by service and size
the price, hours and cleaners of every service and size band with the price per m2, per labour hour and the margin, checked against the market
Office quote with visits per week
price per visit and per month from the area, desks, bathrooms and visits per week, with a premium for work outside office hours
hours, crew size and price from the rooms, the state of the home, the dust level and the days you have, for the jobs that are quoted once
the lowest price worth taking after pay, supplies and travel, and the margin of every quote against your target
the margin after a discount, the break-even discount and the biggest discount that keeps your target margin, with the owner limit
from a cost rise to the new price per visit, the clients not reviewed for 12 months and every price change with its gain per month
every follow-up with the answer, the next step and a flag for open quotes nobody followed up
why quotes are lost, how much cheaper the other offer was, who the competitor was and the monthly value lost
the win rate at a higher price per labour hour and whether the new price earns more per quote sent
hours measured on site against the hours estimated and the area against the quote, so a wrong estimate is found before the first visit
your price against the lowest and highest price you found, with the gap to the middle
Profit share of the price you want on a visit
Win rate you want on quotes
Extra cost on top of pay (payroll tax, insurance)
Cost of a minute on the road

Quotes priced by area, rooms and frequency
One row per quote sent; the price per m2, the hours and margin on the quote, the discount against the rate card, the follow-up and validity checks and the monthly value fill in by themselves.
Clients with price per m2, monthly value and rate card check
One row per client; the price per m2, the monthly value, the price at the rate card, the margin of a visit and the price review check fill in by themselves.
Monthly gain at the rate card
Rate card by service and size band
The price of a visit for every service and size band, with the hours and cleaners it needs; the price per m2, the price per labour hour and the margin fill in by themselves.
Services with the rate per labour hour
The six services with the price per labour hour (one cleaner working for one hour) and the m2 one cleaner does in an hour; every quote and rate card check reads these two numbers.
The extra services on top of the standard clean with their price and the minutes they take; quotes and the add-on pricer read these.
Price factor and visits per month by frequency
The price factor you apply for each frequency (weekly clients pay less per visit than one-offs) and the visits in a month; monthly values read these.
Areas with travel time and surcharge by zone
The four areas you serve, each in three zones (centre, middle, edge) with the travel minutes and the surcharge added to a visit; quotes read the first row of the area, the centre.
Lead sources with cost per lead and usual win rate
Where prospects come from with what a lead costs you and the share of quotes that usually win; compare with the win rate in Quotes.
Follow-ups on quotes with the next step
One row per follow-up message or call on a quote with what the prospect answered; the prospect, the days since the quote and whether the next step is overdue fill in by themselves.
One row per add-on in a quote with the price and minutes; the extra price per hour and the gap to the add-on list price fill in so no add-on is sold below your hourly rate.
Site visits with measured against estimated hours
One row per site visit with the area, the rooms counted and the hours you measured; the hours gap against the estimate and whether the estimate was too low fill in by themselves.
One row per price change told to a client with the reason; the change in money and percent, the day it starts and what it adds each month fill in by themselves.
Lost quotes with the price gap and competitor
One row per quote that was declined or ended with the reason, how much cheaper the other offer was and whether you followed up; the quoted price and the monthly value lost fill in.
Office quotes by area, desks and visits per week
One row per office quote with the area, desks, visits per week and hours per visit; the price per month, per m2 and per hour and the quote status fill in by themselves.
Move-out and deep-clean quotes by rooms and state
One row per move-out clean (a full clean when a client leaves a home), move-in or deep clean quote with rooms, state, add-ons and hours; the price per hour and the status fill in.
Post-construction quotes by area, days and dust
One row per post-construction quote with the area, the days, the dust level and the crew size; the hours on site, the price per day, per m2 and per hour fill in by themselves.
Jobs done with the price per labour hour
A sample of finished jobs with the planned and actual hours per cleaner, the price and the costs; the labour hours, the price per labour hour and the margin fill in by themselves.
Market price checks against the rate card
One row per price check of a service and size band with the lowest and highest market price you found; the market middle, the gap to it and whether you are below or above fill in by themselves.
Price tests with the win rate
One row per price test on a service with the quotes sent and won; the win rate, the price change, whether it is still running and whether to keep the new price fill in by themselves.
The people you message in this suite: the owner, the coordinator, the team leads, the cleaners and the accountant and supplies vendor outside the company.

Quote request sheet with the price check
Quote from the area, service, frequency and add-ons
Type the area, the service, the frequency and up to two add-ons; see the labour hours, the cleaners needed, the price of the visit from your rate card, the cost and the margin.
Quote from the number of rooms and their condition
Type the bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, living rooms and the condition; the minutes per room are yours to change. See the labour hours, the cleaners and the price of a visit.
Visit price and monthly total by frequency
Type the price of one visit at the biweekly rate and the frequency; see the price per visit, the monthly total and how much the client saves against a one-off visit.
Price of one visit at the biweekly rate
Price per visit at this frequency
Saving per visit for the client
Saving share of the one-off price
Price, minutes and margin of the add-ons chosen
Choose up to three add-ons; see the extra minutes, the extra price, the price per hour of the extra work, its cost and margin, and whether it pays for the cleaner time.
Price per hour of the extra work
Price needed for your target margin
Office price per visit and per month
Type the area, desks, bathrooms and visits per week; the minutes per desk and per bathroom are yours to change. See the hours, the price per visit and per month, and the price per m2.
Type the bedrooms, bathrooms, oven, fridge, windows and the state of the home; see the labour hours, the cleaners, the price at the move-out rate and the margin.
Post-construction hours, crew size and price
Type the area, the days you have and the dust level; see the labour hours, the crew size needed to finish in time, the price, the price per day and the margin.
Days with the crew you have
Travel cost and surcharge per visit
Type the area, the minutes on the road, the visits per month and the travel cost you absorb; see the cost of the road per visit, the surcharge you need and what it adds each month.
Minutes on the road per visit
Travel cost you absorb per visit
Minutes on the road per month
The lowest price worth taking for a visit
Type the hours, the crew, the pay, the supplies and the travel; see the cost, the break-even price, the lowest price for your target margin and whether your minimum price is high enough.
Lowest price for your target margin
Profit and margin of a quote
Type the price, the hours, the cleaners, the supplies and the travel minutes; see the cost, the profit, the margin, the profit per labour hour and the price you need for your target margin.
How far you can discount and still earn
Type the list price, the discount asked, the labour hours, the supplies and the travel; see the margin after the discount, the break-even discount and the biggest discount that keeps your margin.
Biggest discount for your target margin
The new price after a cost rise
Type the current price, the cost of a visit, the cost rise and your target margin; see the margin if you do nothing, the price that keeps today's margin and the price for your target.
New monthly revenue from the quotes you send
Type the quotes you send in a month, your win rate, the average monthly value of a client and the monthly loss of clients; see the new clients and the revenue added each month and after a year.
Average monthly value of a client
Share of clients lost each month
Yearly revenue of one month of quotes
Extra revenue each month at your wanted win rate
What-if grid: rate and hours against the profit of a visit
Type the price per labour hour, the labour hours of a visit and your costs; read the profit and break-even rate, and use the grid rows to see how rate and hours move the profit of a visit.

Hello {prospect}, your quote for {service} is ready: {quoted_price} per visit. It is open until {valid_until}.
Hello {prospect}, a reminder that your quote {quote_id} ends on {valid_until}. Shall we book your first visit?
Prospect: can we book a site visit
Hello {prospect}, can we book a short site visit to measure your {area_m2} m2 so that the price is exact? Which day suits you?
Hello {prospect}, a weekly clean has a lower price per visit than the quote {quote_id}. Would you like a new quote?
Hello {prospect}, thank you for choosing us. We will confirm your first visit and your team shortly.
Hello, your cleaning proposal for {office} is attached: {price_visit} per visit, {visits_week} visits per week, {month_price} per month.
Hello {prospect}, your {type} estimate is ready: {price} for about {hours} labour hours. Please tell us the day.
Hello {prospect}, your estimate for {site} is ready: {price} over {days} days with {crew_size} cleaners.
Prospect: a question about your quote
Hello {prospect}, a question about your quote {quote_id}: is the area of {area_m2} m2 right, and is there anything we should add?
Hello {prospect}, we have a free place in the schedule. We can start as soon as you accept quote {quote_id}.
Hello {client}, from {effective_on} the price of your visit changes from {old_price} to {new_price}. Thank you for your trust.
Client: a price review for your contract
Hello {client}, we review prices once a year. Your visit is {price} now. May we call you to talk about your plan?
Hello {client}, would you like an inside oven clean at your next visit? It adds about 45 minutes. Tell us and we add it.
Client: a discount for booking weekly
Hello {client}, a weekly clean has a lower price per visit than your {frequency} plan. Shall we send you the new price?
Client: thank you for a referral
Hello {client}, thank you for recommending us to a friend. We would like to thank you with a small discount on your next visit.
Client: your first visit is confirmed
Hello {client}, your first visit is confirmed. Our team brings everything needed. Your price per visit is {price}.
Owner: a quote is waiting for approval
Hello, quote {quote_id} for {prospect} is {quoted_price}, above the approval limit. Please approve it or change the price.
Hello, the win rate of the last 90 days is {win_90}. Please look at the lost quotes and the prices.
Owner: a client is below the rate card
Hello, {client} pays {price} per visit but the rate card says {fair_price}. Please decide on a price change.
Owner: a quote has no follow-up
Hello, quote {quote_id} for {prospect} has no follow-up after 7 days. Value {quoted_price}.
Owner: the price test has ended
Hello, the price test on {service} ended on {to_on}: win rate {win_rate} against {win_before} before. Result: {verdict}.
Hello, please follow up quote {quote_id} for {prospect} ({service}, {quoted_price}). Follow-up check: {follow_state}.
Hello, please book the site visit on {date} for {prospect} (quote {quote_id}).
Hello, please send the rate card for {service} to {prospect} ({quote_id}).
Hello, please update the price for {client}: {old_price} to {new_price} from {effective_on}.
Hello, please measure the rooms at the site visit for {prospect} on {date}: about {area_m2} m2, {rooms} rooms, condition {condition}.
Hello, the new rate card for the year: {service}, {size_band}, price {price}. Please update your price list.
Hello, our volume of {service} cleans is growing. Please send your best price for supplies for the next three months.
Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.
Price per visit: {col:quotes.quoted_price}. That is {col:quotes.price_m2} per m2 for about {col:quotes.est_hours} labour hours. The quote is open until {col:quotes.valid_until}.
Add-ons are priced on the attached sheet. Prices are before any tax. We confirm the price after a site visit if the home or office differs from what you told us.

We clean {col:offq.visits_week} times per week, about {col:offq.hours_visit} hours each visit. Price per visit: {col:offq.price_visit}. Price per month: {col:offq.month_price}. Work outside office hours: {col:offq.after_hours}.
Supplies and equipment are included. Terms and notice for the yearly contract are on the attached sheet. Prices are before any tax.
Prospect: {col:moveq.prospect}. Type: {col:moveq.type}, {col:moveq.bedrooms} bedrooms and {col:moveq.bathrooms} bathrooms. State of the home: {col:moveq.state}.
Add-ons: {col:moveq.addons}. Labour hours: {col:moveq.hours}. Price: {col:moveq.price}, which is {col:moveq.price_hour} per labour hour.
The price assumes the home is empty and has water and power. We confirm the price on the day if the state of the home is worse than described.

We plan {col:pcq.days} days with {col:pcq.crew_size} cleaners, about {col:pcq.hours_site} labour hours on site. Price: {col:pcq.price}, which is {col:pcq.price_day} per day and {col:pcq.price_m2} per m2.
The price is for one clean after the building work ends. A second visit after more work is priced separately. Prices are before any tax.
Rate card line for a service and size band
Service: {col:rates.service}. Size band: {col:rates.size_band}, from {col:rates.area_from} to {col:rates.area_to} m2.
Labour hours: {col:rates.labour_hours} with {col:rates.cleaners} cleaners. Price: {col:rates.price}, which is {col:rates.price_hour} per labour hour and {col:rates.price_m2} per m2.
Prices are for one visit and before any tax. Recurring clients pay less per visit; the one-off price is higher.
Dear {col:pchg.client}, from {col:pchg.effective_on} the price of your visit changes from {col:pchg.old_price} to {col:pchg.new_price}, a change of {col:pchg.change_amt} ({col:pchg.change_pct}).
Reason: {col:pchg.reason}. We review prices once a year so that we can keep paying our cleaners fairly and keep the quality you know.
Thank you for your trust. If you would like to talk about your plan, please call us before the new price starts.
Dear {col:quotes.prospect}, thank you for accepting quote {col:quotes.quote_id} for {col:quotes.service} ({col:quotes.frequency}) at {col:quotes.quoted_price} per visit.
The monthly value of your plan is {col:quotes.monthly_value}. We will confirm your first visit, your cleaning team and the day of the week by message.
Please tell us how we get into your place and about anything we should not touch. Prices are before any tax.
Dear {col:fups.prospect}, we wrote to you about quote {col:fups.quote_id} {col:fups.after_days} days after it was sent. Last contact: {col:fups.step} on {col:fups.date}, answer: {col:fups.outcome}.
Your quote is still open and we would be glad to answer any question. We can also visit to measure your place so that the price is exact.
Next contact: {col:fups.next_on}. If you prefer not to hear from us, tell us and we will close the quote.
